chapter: Dream band, reading and closing thoughts
title: Closing thanks at the end of the interview
summary: Williams thanks her and congratulates her on turning 80, and they exchange compliments, ending the May 26, 1998 session.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: That’s very true. What a great asset and what a great interview. We’d like to thank Ms. Marian McPartland for a very brilliant brilliant interview, which I think we’ll all find very uplifting, and on behalf . . . My name is James Williams. Congratulations on the, your 80th birthday celebration, and I’m sure there will be at least another 80 in line for us to celebrate there. Keep on with “Piano Jazz” well into the millenium.
Listen. I’ll call you if I make 90.
O.k. I hope we do it before then. [laughter]. But nevertheless we’ll certainly do one that particular year as well.

I should return the compliment and say that in order to get a good interview, the interviewer has to be very good and know what they’re doing and come up with the proper questions and be altogether excellent, which you were, James.
Well thank you. You’ve made me feel very anointed.
So, once again, this is May 26, 1998, and thank you again, Marian.
It’s a pleasure. [Transcribed by Barry Kernfeld from a digital copy of the tape reels]
